shareSummaryHelp: Sends a private link with what you saved: dates, costs, and places. Your name isn't included.

tip1: Check the official page before paying anything.
tip2: Real jobs never ask kids to pay to start, and real scholarships are free to apply for.
tip3: For in-person events, ask who will supervise and how your child will get there.
aboutApp: Rumbo stores your student's information only on their own device. This page shows only what they chose to share — no name or address.
